stages.title: Mineral and primary-material production
stages.description: Extraction and primary processing of metals and natural materials used in the vehicle and traction battery.
stages.logistics: Mine or plantation to refinery by road, rail and bulk ocean freight

stages.title: Refining and engineered materials
stages.description: Conversion into steel, aluminium, copper products, cathode/anode materials and battery-grade chemicals.
stages.logistics: Refinery to material and cell plants by bulk and container freight

stages.title: Tier-2 component production
stages.description: Manufacture of cells, semiconductors, wiring, motors, electronics, glass, tyres and subcomponents.
stages.logistics: Regional component lanes using road, rail, ocean container and air freight for constrained electronics

stages.title: Tier-1 systems integration
stages.description: Integration of battery packs, power electronics, drivetrains, interiors, braking and safety systems.
stages.logistics: Sequenced inbound logistics to the assembly plant

stages.title: Vehicle assembly and finishing
stages.description: Body, paint, final assembly, software loading, inspection and finished-vehicle release.
stages.logistics: Inbound sequenced freight and outbound vehicle compounds

stages.title: Distribution, use and service
stages.description: Finished-vehicle distribution, dealership delivery, maintenance, charging and replacement parts.
stages.logistics: Rail and road finished-vehicle distribution followed by service-parts logistics

stages.title: Dismantling and recovery
stages.description: Collection, battery handling, dismantling, reuse and materials recovery.
stages.logistics: Reverse logistics to authorised dismantlers and battery recyclers

stages.title: Mineral and primary-material production
stages.description: Extraction and primary processing of metals, rubber and catalytic-converter materials.
stages.logistics: Mine or plantation to refinery by road, rail and bulk ocean freight

stages.title: Metals and materials conversion
stages.description: Production of steel, aluminium, copper products, polymers, glass and refined catalytic materials.
stages.logistics: Bulk and container freight to component clusters

stages.title: Tier-2 component production
stages.description: Manufacture of engine parts, electronics, wiring, tyres, castings and subcomponents.
stages.logistics: Regional and international component lanes

stages.title: Tier-1 systems integration
stages.description: Integration of engine, transmission, exhaust, interiors, braking and safety systems.
stages.logistics: Sequenced inbound logistics to the assembly plant

stages.title: Vehicle assembly and finishing
stages.description: Body, paint, powertrain installation, final assembly, testing and release.
stages.logistics: Inbound sequenced freight and outbound vehicle compounds

stages.title: Distribution, use and service
stages.description: Finished-vehicle distribution, fuel-system servicing, maintenance and replacement parts.
stages.logistics: Rail and road finished-vehicle distribution followed by service-parts logistics

stages.title: Dismantling and recovery
stages.description: Vehicle collection, depollution, dismantling and metals recovery.
stages.logistics: Reverse logistics to authorised vehicle dismantlers

stages.title: Mineral and feedstock extraction
stages.description: Extraction of conductive, battery and semiconductor materials.
stages.logistics: Mine to smelter and refinery through bulk and container routes

stages.title: Semiconductor and substrate production
stages.description: Wafer fabrication, packaging, memory, processor and printed-circuit substrate production.
stages.logistics: High-value components move through regional air and ocean lanes

stages.title: Tier-2 components
stages.description: PCBs, displays, power supplies, batteries, motors, enclosures and cables.
stages.logistics: Container and air freight to contract manufacturers

stages.title: Final assembly and test
stages.description: Board integration, mechanical assembly, firmware, functional test and final quality release.
stages.logistics: Consolidated inbound parts and finished-goods export logistics

stages.title: Packaging, distribution and retail
stages.description: Packaging, regional distribution centres, retail and e-commerce fulfilment.
stages.logistics: Ocean or air freight to distribution centres followed by parcel networks

stages.title: Repair and end-of-life
stages.description: Repair, refurbishment, collection, dismantling and materials recovery.
stages.logistics: Reverse logistics to repair hubs and authorised recyclers

stages.title: Mineral extraction
stages.description: Extraction of cathode, anode and conductive materials.
stages.logistics: Mine to concentrator and refinery by road, rail and sea

stages.title: Chemical refining and active materials
stages.description: Battery-grade refining and cathode/anode active-material production.
stages.logistics: Bulk chemicals and powders move to electrode plants

stages.title: Electrode and cell production
stages.description: Coating, drying, calendaring, cell assembly, electrolyte filling and formation.
stages.logistics: Controlled inbound chemical logistics and regulated dangerous-goods outbound

stages.title: Module and pack assembly
stages.description: Cell integration, battery-management systems, cooling, enclosures and testing.
stages.logistics: Dangerous-goods transport to vehicle or storage-system plants

stages.title: Use, second life and recycling
stages.description: Warranty logistics, diagnostics, repurposing, dismantling and material recovery.
stages.logistics: Reverse dangerous-goods logistics to authorised facilities

stages.title: Rough-diamond extraction
stages.description: Industrial or artisanal extraction, recovery and mine-site sorting.
